title: Dr. Papper
subtitle: Buying the loyalty of a great, inspiring, and legendary rock pirate is far easier than you think.

items.text: Dr.Papper
Hmm ...
Indeed, this lake is surrounded by a mysterious fog. Mr. APPLe tries to figure it out, but almost falls into a coma.
The spinning wheel has been on standby for casting some arcane skill.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ms. Vertin! They all wake up!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: However ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Sonetto found Regulus immediately ... They're at a standoff in the lobby.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm coming.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are awake ... How do you feel? Any discomfort?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper ... you made it!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I heard that you caught ... no, you gained the trust of Regulus ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: When I returned to the research center, the committee informed me that Regulus would join the Foundation as our colleague.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am here to convey the committee's commendation and your next mission.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I did not expect that you would just summon me ... In the future, if possible, I hope you could show me the incantation. I would also like to learn it!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Regulus, we are very glad to have you!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: However, you need to go to the Foundation and the Scientific Computing Center first to complete the registration process.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As an arcanist talent rated S, we will provide you with the best equipment for scientific research.
This is a mistake.

branch.speaker: Regulus
branch.text: Yes, it's a mistake. A bloody huge mistake!!

branch.speaker: Regulus
branch.text: Which star said she was ever going to join the Foundation? Ridiculous! Is this Pirate really so easily recruited?

items.text: Congratulations!

branch.speaker: Regulus
branch.text: That wasn't the deal we made!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The institution Vertin told me is a place where the "Storm" can be avoided, free use of arcane skills is guaranteed, and Dr. Papper is even free for 365 days!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Exactly. If it is a place full of serious old men, Regulus must not be interested in it. Sorry for this APPLe's interruption.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What ...?! No, no no! The Foundation is definitely not a place for serious old men!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: That ... That's where Vertin and I grew up. And there are many other interesting people like us ... Ahem! Young people.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Vertin, don't just stand there. Talk to them. Explain that.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Who knew Ms. Sonetto could be so panicked.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Well, at least the Foundation is not that horrible at all.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... I should have more training.
Over shoes, over boots.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Let me explain. Regulus, APPLe, what I invited you to join before is ... the St. Pavlov Foundation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: As for Dr. Papper, I think Sonetto will find a way.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... I will definitely make an application to the administration.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: *tuts* Hah …

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Fine. For the sake of 365 days of free drink, I'll join you.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It shouldn't take too long to go through the procedures, right? I've got a bunch of belongings to pack up. Vertin, you ... come and help me!
Sure.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Three of them leave the room.
TO BE CONTINUED…

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It shouldn't take long to go through the procedures, right? I've got a bunch of belongings to pack up. ... Vertin, you ... come and help me!
